I am a daily claude code user. This post covers building an AI-powered news digest from scratch.

## The AI newsroom

Got the inspiration from a podcast and built a multi-agent editorial system using Ollama for local inference.

### Building the application

Used Ollama Python SDK to call local LLMs, parse RSS feeds, and produce a structured digest.
